svg.aria-label: Index card. Neralu: heatwave check-ins for older people. Calls people who live alone when the heat crosses their own threshold. A worrying answer sends a volunteer to the door. Key result: Hack4SDG 2026 finale. 287 tests. FastAPI, Twilio, React.
